name: Fisetin

track.title: Lab & animal
track.line: Extended mouse lifespan, started late in life (2018)

track.title: Phase II
track.line: Mayo AFFIRM trials since 2018; no results yet

track.title: Dietary supplement
track.line: Sold as a supplement; not reviewed by FDA

what.text: Fisetin is a flavonoid, a plant pigment found in some fruits and vegetables. In a 2018 lab screen of 10 flavonoids, it was the strongest senolytic, meaning it killed senescent cells: old, damaged cells that stop dividing and release inflammatory signals.

Fisetin is sold as a dietary supplement. FDA does not review supplements for safety or effectiveness before sale. No published trial has shown that fisetin removes senescent cells or slows aging in people.

research.text: Fisetin's case rests on mouse studies. In people, most trials are small pilots run by Mayo Clinic and others, many still running. The two Mayo frailty trials (AFFIRM and AFFIRM-LITE) started in 2018 and have posted no results. A few completed trials have posted results on ClinicalTrials.gov without a journal paper.
Each is listed below as it was run.

research.meta: USA · 2018 to now · Phase 2 randomized trials
research.title: Frailty in older adults (AFFIRM, AFFIRM-LITE)

facts.v: Randomized, placebo-controlled, Mayo Clinic; enrolling by invitation
40 women aged 70 and older (AFFIRM); 40 adults aged 70 and older (AFFIRM-LITE), planned
Started February and November 2018; completion listed as November 2027
6-minute walk (AFFIRM); blood inflammation markers (AFFIRM-LITE)

research.found: No results posted and no paper found as of November 1, 2026.

research.meta: USA · 2020 to 2023 · Phase 2 randomized, open-label trial
research.title: Bone turnover in older women, results posted

facts.v: Open-label, randomized, three arms (dasatinib plus quercetin, fisetin, no treatment), Mayo Clinic
74 women aged 60 and older enrolled; 14 in the fisetin arm, 11 analyzed for the main outcome
20 weeks
Change in the bone breakdown marker CTX (main outcome); other bone turnover markers

research.found: Posted results only. Median CTX change was +13.7% on fisetin and -7.7% with no treatment; the registry posts no statistical test for the fisetin arm. One serious adverse event, a stomach bleed, occurred in the fisetin arm.

src.label: NCT04313634 (senolytics and bone, Mayo Clinic), ClinicalTrials.gov

research.title: COVID-19 in nursing-home residents (COVID-FIS)

facts.v: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled pilot, Mayo Clinic; about 20 mg/kg a day by mouth or tube on days 0, 1, 8 and 9
20 adults aged 65 and older in nursing homes (10 per group)
Two 2-day courses a week apart; the trial ran from April 2022 and was stopped early
Change in COVID-19 severity

research.found: Stopped for futility by the safety board and the National Institute on Aging. One serious adverse event in each group.

research.title: COVID-19 in at-risk outpatients (COVFIS-HOME)

facts.v: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled pilot, Mayo Clinic; about 20 mg/kg a day on days 0, 1, 8 and 9
55 adults with COVID-19 at home: 29 fisetin, 26 placebo
Two 2-day courses a week apart; trial ran July 2021 to September 2022
WHO ordinal scale of COVID-19 severity

research.found: Posted results list serious adverse events in 0 of 29 on fisetin and 2 of 26 on placebo. The registry posts no statistical comparison of the main outcome.

research.title: Carpal tunnel syndrome (FITCATS)

facts.v: Single group, no placebo, Mayo Clinic; 100 mg capsules on 2 days, repeated after 1 month
40 adults aged 21 to 80 with carpal tunnel syndrome
About 1 month of dosing; trial ran October 2022 to January 2025
Change in the Boston Carpal Tunnel Questionnaire score; blood senescence markers

research.found: Posted mean change in the symptom score was -0.5. With no control group, this cannot show an effect. No serious adverse events in 40 people.

research.text: A Mayo trial in diabetic and chronic kidney disease (NCT03325322) is listed as suspended.

research.title: Obese men with exercise training, 2026

facts.v: Double-blind, placebo-controlled, four groups (placebo, fisetin, training plus placebo, training plus fisetin)
60 sedentary men with obesity
12 weeks; fisetin 200 mg a day
Asprosin, MCP-1 and adiponectin (main outcomes); leptin; blood fats; body weight

research.found: The fisetin-only group lost more weight than placebo. The largest changes in the main markers were in the training plus fisetin group. These are blood markers, not aging outcomes.

research.text: In mice with a fast-aging syndrome and in old normal mice, fisetin lowered senescence markers in several tissues. Given late in life to normal mice, it reduced age-related tissue damage and extended median and maximum lifespan. It also lowered senescence in human fat tissue in the lab. None of this has been shown in people.

us.text: Fisetin is not an FDA-approved drug. It is sold as a dietary supplement, which FDA does not review for safety or effectiveness before sale. As of November 1, 2026.

side.text: Human safety data on fisetin are thin. Most trials have not published results. In posted results, one stomach bleed occurred in a 14-person fisetin arm. FDA does not review supplements for safety before sale.

items.text: one serious adverse event (gastric hemorrhage) among 14 women in the fisetin arm; none in the other two arms of 30 each.

unconfirmed: We found no journal paper reporting results from Mayo's AFFIRM or AFFIRM-LITE trials, or from the fisetin arm of the bone trial (NCT04313634).
The AFFIRM registry records do not state the fisetin dose.
We could not confirm fisetin's status with Health Canada, the UK, EU regulators or the TGA.
The 2026 trial in obese men does not state its country in the abstract we read.
surprises: Fisetin is often described as a senolytic for people, but Mayo's two frailty trials, started in 2018, have posted no results eight years later.
In the only posted fisetin result on bone, the bone breakdown marker rose on fisetin (+13.7%) while it fell with no treatment (-7.7%), with no statistical test posted.
A Mayo COVID-19 trial of fisetin in nursing homes was stopped for futility.
